title: Mike Macdonald: Seven personal fouls "unacceptable on any level"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald: Seven personal fouls "unacceptable on any level"
sources.description: The Seahawks had a 21-point lead over the Chargers in the third quarter on Sunday, but the Chargers had the ball with a chance to tie or win the game with less than two minutes to play.
